summary_1line: Several kings offer Yayati their earned heavenly worlds to stop his fall, but he repeatedly refuses, insisting it is improper to accept another’s religious merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged king Yayati stands mid-descent from heaven while surrounding kings offer him their luminous celestial worlds.
King Sivi, radiant and resolute, stretches out his hands as if giving away his infinite lightning-bright heavens to Yayati.
